name: hdr.mapVersion
meaning: map version 0x0102 = V1.2 (V1.1 + event block + type blocks)

name: hdr.typeCode
meaning: device type: 1 CNC, 2 pallet system, 3 load station, 4 station, 5 test bench, 6 AGV, 7 AS/RS

name: hdr.unitId
meaning: unit id (plausibility: wrong IP / cable)

name: hdr.heartbeat
meaning: +1 every second, wraps 65535 -> 0; frozen = PLC program stopped

name: std.status
meaning: bit0 run, bit1 idle, bit2 set-up, bit3 alarm, bit4 e-stop (copy), bit5 blocked, bit6 starved, bit7 no shift

name: std.mode
meaning: 0 manual, 1 auto, 2 set-up, 3 maintenance

name: std.stateCode
meaning: 0 OFF 1 IDLE 2 RUN 3 SETUP 4 DOWN 5 BLOCKED 6 STARVED

name: std.alarm
meaning: alarm code, 0 = none

name: hs.status
meaning: bit0 ACK toggle (= REQ when accepted), bit1 BUSY, bit2 DONE toggle, bit3 REJECT, bit4 READY

name: hs.ackSeq
meaning: sequence number of the last accepted / rejected command

name: hs.result
meaning: 0 OK, 1 unknown command, 2 not ready, 3 bad data, 4 busy

name: hs.lotDone
meaning: pieces done of the current job

name: std.good
meaning: good parts counter

name: std.scrap
meaning: scrap counter

name: std.lastCycle_s
meaning: last cycle time

name: std.order
meaning: current job / work order

name: std.part
meaning: current part code

name: std.power_kW
meaning: electrical power

name: std.energy_kWh
meaning: energy counter

name: evt.counter
meaning: number of state changes since power-on (event block, thesis Table 5.2)

name: evt.tLast_ms
meaning: PLC time of the last state change

name: evt.ring0
meaning: event ring entry 0 (newest first): state code; followed by time ms (UINT32, 2 registers)

name: evt.ring1
meaning: event ring entry 1 (newest first): state code; followed by time ms (UINT32, 2 registers)

name: evt.ring2
meaning: event ring entry 2 (newest first): state code; followed by time ms (UINT32, 2 registers)

name: evt.ring3
meaning: event ring entry 3 (newest first): state code; followed by time ms (UINT32, 2 registers)

name: evt.ring4
meaning: event ring entry 4 (newest first): state code; followed by time ms (UINT32, 2 registers)

name: evt.ring5
meaning: event ring entry 5 (newest first): state code; followed by time ms (UINT32, 2 registers)

name: evt.ring6
meaning: event ring entry 6 (newest first): state code; followed by time ms (UINT32, 2 registers)

name: evt.ring7
meaning: event ring entry 7 (newest first): state code; followed by time ms (UINT32, 2 registers)

name: cmd.code
meaning: 1 load order, 2 start, 3 stop, 4 ack alarm, 5 recipe; 10 run job, 11 move pallet, 12 operator task, 13 start test, 14 tool data, 20 transport, 21 charge, 30 store, 31 retrieve

name: cmd.seq
meaning: message counter (+1 per command), copied to hs.ackSeq

name: cmd.ctl
meaning: bit0 REQ toggle – write LAST; device answers ACK = REQ

name: cmd.order
meaning: work order for command 1

name: cmd.part
meaning: part code for command 1

name: cmd.recipe
meaning: recipe / NC program no. for commands 1 and 5

name: cmd.lotQty
meaning: lot quantity for command 1

name: cmd.gwHeartbeat
meaning: gateway heartbeat (+1 per second, FC06); PLC watchdog 5 s

name: load.palletId
meaning: pallet at the load station

name: load.clamped
meaning: 1 = fixture clamped (pressure switch)

name: load.operatorReady
meaning: 1 = operator pressed READY

name: load.partPresent
meaning: 1 = part present sensor

name: job.idDone
meaning: id of the last finished job

name: job.result
meaning: 0 OK, 1 NOK / scrap, 2 aborted, 3 rejected

name: job.cycle_s
meaning: duration of the last job

name: job.id
meaning: job id from the cell controller (commands >= 10)

name: task.type
meaning: 1 load raw part, 2 unload machined, 3 unload + load, 4 change fixture

name: task.palletId
meaning: pallet of the task

name: task.variant
meaning: variant to load (1-3)

name: job.text
meaning: serial no. / item code of the job
